title: Adaptive Trustworthy Edge Systems: Dynamic Risk-Driven Cascades and Real-Time SLA Bounds

research_question.question: Can perception risk be converted into an adaptive edge inference policy that improves the latency/verification trade-off while respecting the 5 ms SLA?
research_question.falsifiable_hypothesis: Dynamic risk routing achieves >= 300 FPS throughput with P99 latency < 5.0 ms while reducing active heavy model compute duty cycle to < 10%.
research_question.logical_necessity: Static primary compromises safety; static heavy violates 5ms latency SLA (14.501 ms). Conditional risk routing is necessary to operate on the Pareto frontier.
research_question.evaluation_capability: Benchmark evaluates Static Primary vs Static Heavy vs Adaptive Cascade under identical edge workloads.
research_question.conclusion_alignment: Conclusions directly supported by measured 373.3 FPS, P99=4.556 ms, 48% bypass, and 8.1% heavy duty cycle.
research_question.standalone_viability: Paper stands completely independently as an edge systems and queuing optimization paper.

novelty_analysis.primary_contribution: Dynamic risk-driven cascade architecture routing frames conditioned on continuous perception risk R_p.
novelty_analysis.secondary_contribution: Graceful degradation overload containment protocol bounding latency under queue congestion.
novelty_analysis.theoretical_contribution: Zero duality gap theorem for continuum cascades via Fenchel-Rockafellar duality + Pollaczek-Khinchine M/G/1 queue delay and Kingman tail bounds.
novelty_analysis.empirical_contribution: 373.3 FPS throughput, 2.679 ms mean latency, P50=3.786 ms, P95=4.075 ms, P99=4.556 ms, 48% primary bypass, 8.1% heavy compute duty cycle.
novelty_analysis.engineering_contribution: Asynchronous verification dispatch and non-blocking queue scheduling on edge hardware.
novelty_analysis.genuinely_new: Constrained Pareto optimization formulation directly coupling evidential perception risk R_p with queuing stability bounds.
novelty_analysis.must_not_be_called_novel: Classical model cascades, general M/G/1 queue formulas.
novelty_analysis.reviewer_challenge_flag: LOW_RISK (Explicit distinction between empirical benchmarks and theoretical queuing proofs).

methodology_depth.constrained_optimization: min E[E] subject to E[L] <= L_SLA and E[R] <= epsilon_risk.
methodology_depth.zero_duality_gap: Proven via convexity of risk objective over space of measurable routing functions.
methodology_depth.queuing_model: Pollaczek-Khinchine mean wait W_q = lambda E[S^2] / [2(1-rho)] and Kingman heavy-traffic tail bounds.
methodology_depth.duty_cycle_definition: 8.1% active heavy execution time fraction representing a 91.9% reduction in continuous heavy power duty cycle.

results_interpretation_3layer.what: Adaptive cascade sustains 373.3 FPS throughput with P99 latency of 4.556 ms (<5.0 ms SLA). Primary bypass rate is 48.0%, verification invocation is 52.0%, and active heavy duty cycle is 8.1%.
results_interpretation_3layer.why: Unambiguous clean frames (48%) terminate immediately in 1.264 ms; heavy verification is invoked intermittently on 52% of frames without causing queue backpressure.
results_interpretation_3layer.limit: Verified under arrival rate lambda <= 200 Hz. Does NOT guarantee <5.0 ms SLA under continuous adversarial DoS saturation (lambda > 1/L_2).

ablation_sufficiency.ablation_status: SUFFICIENT (Directly isolates Static Primary, Static Heavy, and Adaptive Cascade)

failure_boundaries.tested_range: Continuous streaming inference at standard edge arrival rates (lambda <= 200 Hz).
unmeasured_limitations: Direct hardware shunt resistor energy measurements

expansion_decision.justification: Paper 23 presents an optimal balance of systems theory, zero duality gap proof, queuing bounds, and verified edge runtime telemetry.
